question: Which of the following is NOT an 'operating system'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tally.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• TALLY full form – **Transactions Allowed in a Linear Line Yards**. 
 
• Tally is strong **accounting software.**
 
• **Tally could be a complete system for business accounting and inventory management.**
 
• It provides many facilities like **Govt**.
 
• It also helps with **preparing balance sheets, filing tax returns and profit/loss statements, fund flow statements, calculating GST etc.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ​​The **Android platform** involves an operating system based upon the **Linux kernel, a GUI, an internet browser and end-user applications** that may be downloaded.
 
• Ubuntu is **an open-source Debian-based Linux distribution**.
 
• Linux mint is a **software system** for desktop and laptop computers.
